Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Birthday Magazine?

A personalized 12-page digital birthday magazine made from the buyer’s answers and selected photos.

What will I receive?

A 12-page US Letter PDF, including a front cover and back cover.

Do I need design experience?

No. The magazine follows a fixed page structure; you share the photos and stories instead of designing pages in Canva.

Does the free preview upload my photo?

No. The optional single cover photo is previewed from a browser-local object URL. The preview does not send it to the site and makes no AI calls.

Why do I need an account?

An authenticated account is required to access the private order workspace and order-bound proof and delivery.

What is included in the revision?

US$39.99 includes one bounded revision batch for small factual, tone or wording changes and photo swaps of up to three images.

How long are photos and the final PDF kept?

After final delivery, source photos and working files are deleted within 24 hours. The final PDF remains available for 72 hours.
